label: Unifocal — right frontal
description: A single, well-circumscribed lesion on the right (+x). The baseline case: one connected mass, moderate WT:TC ratio.

label: Multifocal — left hemisphere
description: Two separate lesions on the left (-x), each independently nested WT/TC/ET. Exercises the connectivity analysis's real differentiator: "is it one mass or two?" answered as 2, not 1.

label: Large diffuse — extensive oedema
description: A large whole-tumour extent with a small solid core — a high WT:TC ratio, unlike the compact baseline case. Produces a larger, more irregular uncertainty footprint at the (now much bigger) boundary.
